title: Boolean

title: Hologram is Interactable/Clickable/Touchable

title: Is A Hologram
description: Checks if an entity is a hologram

title: Location is Within
description: Checks if a location is between two locations
syntax_pattern:
%locations% (is|are) within [[the] location] %location% and [[the] location] %location%
%locations% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) within [[the] location] %location% and [[the] location] %location%

title: Slime Chunk
description: Checks if a chunk is a slime chunk.

title: Spell Exists
description: Checks if an elementals spell exists.

title: Spell Type

title: Add Item Line

title: Build Paste
description: Create's a pastebin paste. You should only call this once per paste. The developer key is linked to your pastebin account and found at this website: https://pastebin.com/doc_api#1

title: Glowing ItemStack
description: Makes a glowing(enchanted with no enchant flag) item.

title: Can Break Block
description: Checks if an item type can break a block.

title: Can See

title: Add Text Line
description: Adds a line of text to the hologram.

title: Create Hologram
description:
Creates a hologram at the specified location with the id specified. The ID must be unique.
IMPORTANT: Holograms are not persistant over restart (for the moment), so make sure to recreate the holograms on script load!
syntax_pattern: create [a] [(hd|holographic[ ]displays)] holo[gram] at %location% [with [the]] id %string% (to be (hidden|invisible) [by default]|) ([and] [to] not (allow|accept|show|translate) placeholders|)

title: Create Paste
description: Creates a new pastebin paste. The ID must be unique.

title: Delete Hologram
description: Deletes a hologram

title: Enchant Item
description: Add an elementals spell to an item

title: Evaluate Effect
description: Execute a Skript effect from a string.

title: Fake Damage
description: Makes a player look like they took damage.

title: Force Sleep
description: Forces a player to sleep at a location as long as there is a bed at that location.

title: Force Wake
description: Forces a player to wake up if they are sleeping.

title: Refresh Chunks
description: Refeshes the chunks given asynchronously.

title: Register Elementals Spell
description:
Registers a new elementals spell which can be cast.
The spell name and id has to be unique, or the spell will not be created.
IMPORTANT: The function has to return a boolean, and return true where you want the cooldown to be applied, and false where not.
syntax_pattern: (create|make|register) a[n] [new] (generic|entity) [elementals] spell named %string% with [the] id %number% to run [[the] function] [on cast] <(.+)>([<.*?>]) with [(a|the)] cooldown [of] %number% seconds

title: Register Placeholder
description:
Registers a placeholder for HolographicDisplays only.
IMPORTANT: If a hologram is created before a placeholder is registered, you need to recreate the placeholder.
syntax_pattern: register [[a] holo[graphic[ displays]]] placeholder %string% to run [[the] function] <(.+)>([<.*?>])

title: Remove Line
description: Removes a line from a hologram

title: Reset Visibility
description: Resets the visibility of a hologram to its default visibility.

title: Rotate Player
description: Rotates a player without teleportation.

title: Set Paste Title

title: Set Paste Visibility

title: Nearest Structure
description:
Find the closest nearby structure of a given structure type. Will not be set if not found. Finding unexplored structures can, and will, block if the world is looking in chunks that gave not generated yet. This can lead to the world temporarily freezing while locating an unexplored structure.
The radius is not a rigid square radius. Each structure may alter how many chunks to check for each iteration. Do not assume that only a radius x radius chunk area will be checked. For example, a woodland mansion can potentially check up to 20,000 blocks away (or more) regardless of the radius used.
This will not load or generate chunks. This can also lead to instances where the server can hang if you are only looking for unexplored structures. This is because it will keep looking further and further out in order to find the structure.

title: Roman Numerals
description: Returns the given number in roman numerals.
syntax_pattern:
[[the] value of] %number% in roman numeral[s]
[the] roman numeral[s] [value] of %number%

title: Create Laser/Guardian Beam

(make|set) [the] line %numbers% of %hologram% [to be] [((un|non[(-| )])|)]touchable
(make|set) [the] line %numbers% of %hologram% [to be] [((un|non[(-| )])|)]interactable
